step: S-14 (LAW §10, pass 6): the four masking fallbacks the widened B17 names on the tree, each cured at its cause: the SFC bundle fold and the utility scan read the SFC bundle unconditionally (a missing bundle fails the build), Tailwind's theme is read unconditionally (a dependency the build already resolved), and the code highlighter's chunk load rejects loudly instead of returning

reasons.why: the fold reads the staged index.css and the SFC bundle unconditionally: a build that did not write either fails here, instead of shipping ./styles without the component CSS
the SFC bundle is always scanned: a missing bundle fails the read below instead of dropping its classes from the utility scan
Tailwind's theme.css is read unconditionally: the build resolved the package above, so a missing theme is a broken install and fails
existsSync has no reader left in this file

the highlighter chunk's load is not swallowed: a failed load rejects highlight() and surfaces through Vue's error handling, while the raw text Vue already painted stays (the text is the primary, the colour is the enhancement)
